name: 3D Ray Tracing (3DRT)
aliases: tomographic projection computation using 3D ray tracing
definition: A method for computing tomographic projections and light dose in volumetric additive manufacturing by computationally casting optical rays in three dimensions, accounting for non-telecentricity and finite etendue, unlike the parallel-ray assumption of the Radon transform.
summary: 3D Ray Tracing simulates volumetric additive manufacturing by casting multiple rays per pixel through optical systems, accounting for refraction and finite etendue unlike idealized parallel projection methods.
